exposure: operative vaginal deliveries (OVDs) performed at night
operative vaginal deliveries (OVDs) performed by day
cohort: Nulliparous women requiring an operative vaginal delivery with a term singleton fetus in a cephalic presentation
finding: There was no association between time of operative vaginal delivery (day vs night) and adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was no association found between the time of day an operative vaginal delivery (OVD) was performed and adverse perinatal outcomes.
